chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from someone who narrated to him, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
That he did not see any problem in a walking person performing salat while he was walking, but he should not be driving the camels.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.بَأْسًا: harm or objection; something blameworthy or problematic
key_terms.حَرِيزٌ: Ḥarīz, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.يَمْشِي: he walks; he is in motion on foot

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat while walking during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat during travel or movement. It indicates that performing salat while walking is not considered problematic, provided that one is not simultaneously occupied with driving camels.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1316 - Hariz reported from someone who narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that
he did not see any problem with praying while walking, as long as he was not driving the camels.
